title: Strassen's Matrix Multiply
description: Write a Zig program that demonstrates matrix multiplication using the Strassen algorithm on 2x2 matrices.
hints: Strassen's algorithm multiplies 2x2 matrices using 7 multiplications instead of 8
The 7 products (p1-p7) combine sub-expressions of A and B
Results are computed by adding/subtracting the products
